comment: Pre-annotator missed every mention (20) of the revised judgment 5A_89/2020; added as DOCKET. The Reglement ueber die Parteientschaedigung has an SR number (SR 173.110.210.3), so Art. 12 dieses Reglements and Art. 4 des Reglements are BARE_ARTICLE (act given as title), not CONTRACT_ARTICLE.
